Added a bounded1-second retry to test tooling, preserving failed evidence; complete B6JJ repeat passed. No product-code change.

Strengthened repeated-separator and decoded JSON key/value scanning, with synthetic regression tests. The first preliminary source clone is retained privately and must never be published; final candidate is a new independent public-main clone with no contaminated private Git objects.
